name: ModelVariant455_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant455_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (eight bloom groups, a rainbow disc, twelve fans and a four-quad sheet around the active slot's first part, aimed at the opposite slot); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-472/622 images build the same source through french_model_variant/variant472_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH and bind the helpers and tables at the French addresses (mesh 4 bytes earlier, spiral 0xC earlier, sheets 0x28 later, tables 0x24 higher). HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
